sections.name: BASIS OF JURISDICTION
sentences: The jurisdiction of this court is based on the diversity of citizenship between the parties.
This action is brought under 28 U.S.C. § 1332.

sections.name: CITIZENSHIP OF PRINCIPAL PARTIES
sentences: Plaintiff is a citizen of Pennsylvania.
Defendant is also a citizen of Pennsylvania.

sections.name: NATURE OF SUIT
sentences: This suit is a contract action.

sections.name: PERSONAL INJURY
sentences: The plaintiff has suffered personal injuries as a result of the defendant's actions.
The plaintiff seeks damages for these injuries.

sections.name: PROPERTY DAMAGE
sentences: The plaintiff has also suffered property damage as a result of the defendant's actions.
The plaintiff seeks compensation for this damage.
The defendant's actions were tortious and caused harm to the plaintiff.
The plaintiff seeks damages for this harm.

sections.name: PERSONAL PROPERTY
sentences: The defendant's actions resulted in the theft of personal property belonging to the plaintiff.
The plaintiff seeks recovery of this property.

sections.name: PRISONER PETITIONS
sentences: This action is not a prisoner petition.

sections.name: TAX SUITS
sentences: This action does not involve tax suits.

sections.name: OTHER LAWSUITS
sentences: This action involves other types of lawsuits, including contract and tort claims.

sections.name: CAUSE OF ACTION
sentences: The cause of action in this case is based on the defendant's breach of contract.
The plaintiff seeks damages for this breach.

sections.name: REQUESTED IN COMPLAINT
sentences: The plaintiff requests that the court grant relief in accordance with the complaint.
